import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1 << 29;
    static final int MAXN = 500;
    static List<Edge>[] graph;
    static int[] level, it;
    static int n, t, sx, sy;
    static int[][] temp = new int[11][11];
    static boolean[][] pass = new boolean[11][11];

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap, flow;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, int flow) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int a, int b, int cap) {
        graph[a].add(new Edge(b, graph[b].size(), cap, 0));
        graph[b].add(new Edge(a, graph[a].size() - 1, 0, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(0);
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && level[n * n * 2 + 1] == -1) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge ed : graph[v]) {
                if (level[ed.to] == -1 && ed.flow < ed.cap) {
                    level[ed.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(ed.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[n * n * 2 + 1] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (v == n * n * 2 + 1) return flow;
        for (; it[v] < graph[v].size(); it[v]++) {
            Edge ed = graph[v].get(it[v]);
            if (level[ed.to] != level[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(ed.to, Math.min(flow, ed.cap - ed.flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                ed.flow += pushed;
                graph[ed.to].get(ed.rev).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(it, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(0, INF)) > 0)
                flow += pushed;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static int way(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, x1, y1});
        int[][] h = new int[11][11];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(h[i], INF);

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int v = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];
            h[x][y] = v;

            if (x > 0 && pass[x - 1][y] && h[x - 1][y] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x - 1 == x2 && y == y2);
                int lim = temp[x - 1][y];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x - 1, y});
            }
            if (y > 0 && pass[x][y - 1] && h[x][y - 1] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x == x2 && y - 1 == y2);
                int lim = temp[x][y - 1];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x, y - 1});
            }
            if (x < n - 1 && pass[x + 1][y] && h[x + 1][y] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x + 1 == x2 && y == y2);
                int lim = temp[x + 1][y];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x + 1, y});
            }
            if (y < n - 1 && pass[x][y + 1] && h[x][y + 1] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x == x2 && y + 1 == y2);
                int lim = temp[x][y + 1];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x, y + 1});
            }
        }
        return h[x2][y2];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        graph = new ArrayList[MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        level = new int[MAXN];
        it = new int[MAXN];

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        char ch;
        int k = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String row = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ch = row.charAt(j);
                temp[i][j] = t;
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    pass[i][j] = false;
                } else if (ch == 'Y') {
                    pass[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    pass[i][j] = true;
                }
                addEdge(0, k++, (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - '0');
            }
        }

        k = n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String row = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ch = row.charAt(j);
                addEdge(k++, n * n * 2 + 1, (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - '0');
            }
        }

        q.add(new int[]{0, sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int v = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];
            temp[x][y] = v;
            if (x > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x - 1][y] && pass[x - 1][y])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x - 1, y});
            if (y > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x][y - 1] && pass[x][y - 1])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x, y - 1});
            if (x < n - 1 && v + 1 < temp[x + 1][y] && pass[x + 1][y])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x + 1, y});
            if (y < n - 1 && v + 1 < temp[x][y + 1] && pass[x][y + 1])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x, y + 1});
        }

        k = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int k1 = n * n;
                k++;
                for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                    for (int w = 0; w < n; w++) {
                        k1++;
                        if (pass[i][j] && pass[z][w] && way(i, j, z, w) <= t)
                            addEdge(k, k1, INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
